measurement: tympanum diameter about 58% of eye diameter, holotype (stated as 'about')
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; the paper prints the proportion in the Description of the holotype
conditions: Holotype ZSM 169/2019 (ACZCV 0940), printed as 'adult female collected on 30 January 2013 at Anketsakely' (the holotype description opens 'ZSM 169/2019, female (Figs 1A, 3).'); one individual, approximate proportion ('about 58%'). Paratypes as printed (three, no total printed): ZSM 167/2019 (ACZCV 0968), 'subadult undetermined'; ZSM 168/2019 (ACZCV 0966), 'juvenile undetermined'; ZSM 166/2019 (ACZCV 0939), 'juvenile undetermined', all from Ankarafa Forest. The Variation section prints different paratype proportions: ZSM 167/2019 'tympanum distinct, ca. 50% of eye diameter' and ZSM 168/2019 'tympanum distinct, approximately the same size of the eye'; only the holotype value is logged. Methods: 'Voucher specimens were euthanised in MS-222 solution, fixed in 90% ethanol and preserved in 70% ethanol.' and 'Morphological measurements (in millimetres) were taken for the four individuals using a dial calliper (Wiha, dialMax) to the nearest 0.1 mm by A.C.' Table 1 (mm) prints TD 1.1 and ED 1.9 for the holotype (1.1/1.9 = 0.58, consistent). Same clause: tympanum 'distinct'. The Diagnosis does not mention the tympanum. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

measurement: tympanic membrane presence in the holotype description
value: tympanic membrane absent, tympanic annulus not visible
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype
conditions: Holotype CORBIDI 15769, printed as 'an adult male' (SVL 15.6 mm), preserved; one individual. No Paratypes heading is printed; the type series also holds a Paratopotype, CORBIDI 15770, printed as 'an adult female'. Methods: 'Specimens were preserved in 70% ethanol.' Table 1 ('Measurements (in mm) of type series') nevertheless prints 'Tympanum diameter' 0.8 for the holotype (1.0 for the paratopotype) and 'Eye to tympanum distance' 0.3, so a tympanum diameter was measured although the text says the membrane is absent and the annulus not visible; the paper does not reconcile these. The Diagnosis item (2) words it differently: 'tympanic membrane not differentiated, tympanic annulus barely visible below skin'; Comparisons distinguish the species 'by lacking a tympanic membrane'. The quote is the single holotype-description sentence, with one cut marked; the cut text covers head proportions, eye, snout, nostrils, lores, lips, tubercles and eyelid width and none of it qualifies this value. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

The quote is the second sentence of the holotype description (the first is 'Adult female (Figs 2-4), 64.9 mm SVL, body robust.'), with two cuts marked; the cut text covers snout, nostril, interorbital and eye proportions, the supratympanic fold ('supratympatic fold prominent, extending from below eye across upper and posterior margins of tympanum towards posterior end of mouth and down to arm insertion'), the region behind the head, vomerine teeth, choanae and tongue, and none of it qualifies the tympanum value. Same clause: tympanic membrane and annulus evident. The Diagnosis adds 'tympanic membrane and annulus evident, partially covered by supratympanic fold'. 'Measurements of the holotype (in mm)' prints ED=6.9 and TD=2.8 (2.8/6.9 = 0.41, consistent). Anatomy only; hearing not tested.

structure: tympanum diameter relative to eye diameter
measurement: tympanum 44.4% of eye diameter, holotype (text; Table 2 holotype TD 0.9 / ED 1.0 disagrees)
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; the paper prints the proportion in the Holotype description
conditions: Holotype as printed: 'INPA-H (Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia) 47568 (field number APL 24805; Fig. 2), adult male', collected 15 March 2024. Paratypes as printed: 'Twelve adult specimens (7 males and 5 females), same locality as holotype' (INPA-H and MPEG numbers listed by date); no paratype tympanum value was used. One individual. Methods: 'The specimens were anesthetized and killed with 5% topical lidocaine.'; preservation is a clause of a longer sentence: '[...] the specimens were fixed in 10% formalin and preserved in 70% ethanol.' Measurements 'to the nearest 0.01 mm using a stereomicroscope [...] except for SVL, which was measured with a digital caliper to the nearest 0.1 mm.' Eye-size passage: Methods name 'tympanum diameter (TD), eye-tympanum distance (DET), eye diameter (ED)' in the morphometric list (following Brown et al. 2011) and print no sentence defining how eye diameter was measured; the holotype description's preceding eye sentence reads 'Eye-nostril distance 1.5 mm, 74.0% of horizontal eye diameter.' Units mm. Whole sentence quoted, no cut; the preceding sentence reads 'Tympanic annulus and tympanic membrane present.' The Characterization gives '(15) tympanum visible, tympanic membrane poorly differentiated, tympanum diameter 38–48% of eye diameter;'. ANOMALY: Table 2 prints the holotype as TD 0.9 and ED 1.0 (mm), which does not give 44.4%; the text's 74.0% eye-nostril figure implies an eye about 2.0 mm, so the table's holotype ED looks misprinted (main's desk-d343 row flags the same 1.0 mm value); the paper does not comment. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
